title: 2 up 1 down
author: Devon B.
desc: A way for me to focus on lifts I love, progress them, and recover. I find this way of lifting a good mix of being a gym rat and family man. Training week is structured: AB rest CD rest EF rest. I didn’t do it the app like that because I’m lazy 🤙
